criteria.text: An exit-zero report with a missing required fixture or skipped required test shows incomplete validation and the affected test IDs.
Complete required coverage can pass with optional skips; I can still see their reasons and the original evidence source and limits.
Missing, partial, stale, incompatible and unknown evidence stay distinct and give no current native proof.
I can see selected, started and completed observations, duplicate occurrences and distinct IDs; duplicate passes cannot fill a missing required ID.
A compatible prior report shows the actual lost test IDs even when totals match; an incompatible or unknown baseline is marked incomparable.
Candidate edits cannot lower the reviewed required inventory without matching review; absent or changed review binding gives no current proof.
Required gates and verified fixture identities must match; an unexecuted gate, failed test, unknown execution or incompatible artifact cannot pass.
Reading saved evidence does no execution or repair; notes, typed origin claims, modeled results and declared counts cannot become native proof.
